output.headline: Same-sub-sector precedent and a 12.5x price paid make Intermountain a credible but long-shot buyer, with no Midwest footprint.
output.differentiator: Its one deal sits in the target's own sub-sector and paid 12.5x, close to the 12.8x comparable median. Peer comparison lines were not provided, so no lead is claimed. [T:record, V:comps]
output.why_them: Same-sub-sector platform buyer; paid near the comparable median

acquirer_overview.title: A health system with a single, large 2022 platform deal
points: Strategic buyer, home sub-sector Healthcare Services; 33 hospitals in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana, headquartered in Salt Lake City [B:buyer, P:2].
Completed a merger with SCL Health in 2022 (April), extending into Colorado, Kansas and Montana; it left Kansas in 2024 [P:1, P:2].
One deal in the file, closed in 2022, a control platform investment; it sits 10th on the priority list at a 3.6% likelihood [T:record, K:closed_share, R:rank].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Sub-sector focus is the case; platform intent supports it
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood [S:sector_share].
Its one deal was tagged Platform Build, Scale and Cross-sell (1 of 1 each), motives seen on only 23%, 23% and 21% of all deals [M:platform_build, M:scale, M:cross_sell].
Target margin is close to what it usually buys (a modest factor), and the deal is not bigger than any it has done [S:margin_fit, S:not_bigger].

precedent_activity.title: One relevant precedent, much larger than this target
points: Paramount Care Partners, 2022: $789M platform investment in Healthcare Services, closed at 12.5x EV/EBITDA and 3.03x EV/Revenue [D:MA-2022-0183].
The precedent was Multi-Regional; no deals in the Midwest and 0 of 1 in the $100M-$400M size band [K:by_region, K:size_band].
Deals in recent years count against it as a slight factor, given a single deal in one active year [S:recency, K:years_active].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and its past multiple is close
points: Comparable range is 10.7x to 15.3x EV/EBITDA across 70 deals, median 12.8x; 9 are in the target's own sub-sector [V:comps].
A 75th percentile ask is defensible: the 16.8% margin sits above the comps' 12.9% median and above 87% of comparable deals [V:comps].
Its own median paid is 12.5x. Synergy headroom is $15M-$25M; buyer revenue was not researched, so balance-sheet capacity is unconfirmed [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: No Midwest presence
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region, and the footprint is Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana [K:by_region, P:2].
risk_flags.mitigant: Its one deal was multi-regional and tagged geographic expansion [D:MA-2022-0183, M:geographic_expansion].
risk_flags.reality: It exited Kansas in 2024, so Midwest appetite is unproven [P:2].

risk_flags.title: Thin record
risk_flags.concern: One deal, in 2022, gives little basis to predict behaviour; recency is a slight factor against [T:record, S:recency].
risk_flags.mitigant: That deal was in the target's own sub-sector and closed [D:MA-2022-0183, K:closed_share].
risk_flags.reality: It ranks 10th of 10 on the priority list, 15th overall of 107 scored [R:rank].

risk_flags.title: Size and capacity unconfirmed
risk_flags.concern: Its only deal was $789M against a $200M target, and buyer revenue was not researched [D:MA-2022-0183, V:synergy].
risk_flags.mitigant: The target is not bigger than any deal it has done [S:not_bigger].
risk_flags.reality: Ability to pay rests on $15M-$25M of synergy headroom, not on balance-sheet data [V:synergy].

conviction.rationale: Only one deal in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and none in the target's region leave the basis neutral, so this is a long-shot call. [C:conviction]
